report.title: Settle the tool-sentinel detector inversion that corrupts every fetch-based unit
report.question_or_target: does the tool-sentinel PostToolUse hook report FAILED (exit code 200) only for WebFetch, or does it also fire for WebSearch and Read in the same session - i.e. is the inversion WebFetch-specific or general?
report.answer: Field-general, not WebFetch-specific. Historical 9e4f0e55 treats status_code as a process exit code at historical-9e4f0e55-sentinel.py:223 / historical-9e4f0e55-sentinel.py:235: any tool whose response carries status_code=200 is FAILED (exit code 200), measured on WebSearch, Read, and WebFetch. Constructed same-session content-only WebSearch/Read stay SUCCESS while WebFetch 200/404 both FAILED (SUCCESS,SUCCESS,FAILED,FAILED), so that fetch verdict measures nothing. Current f7fac7b4 (sha256 7ec7f9b172c818670b2ccfa5c27a1ab36c7de68861621b6681359e59f63c444e) uses HTTP >=400 and yields SUCCESS,SUCCESS,SUCCESS,FAILED. Real Claude event-bus envelopes remain NOT-CHECKED.
